ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a high-intensity (white) pixel ratio of approximately 8:92. High-intensity pixels are primarily concentrated at distal tips and isolated mid-surface spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes. A distinct high-contrast annular ring is visible on the mid-left lobe. Sparse, low-density white mottling is distributed across the central dark field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with an approximate 70-degree interior angle between the interior margins of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. Amplitudes of variations are most significant on the outer thirds of the lobes, presenting as jagged peaks against the background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch, terminating in highly irregular, jagged distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast annular ring (circular cluster) on the left lobe mid-section. Dense, irregular high-contrast clusters located on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular high-contrast structural build-up or erosion on the distal tips of both lobes; distinct circular ring scar on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The circular 'O' shaped high-contrast mark on the left fluke lobe is a primary distinctive identifier.
